create.name: Nathalie Jaspar
create.bio:
Nathalie Jaspar is reiki’s great conversationalist — the New York City–based reiki master who decided the field’s deepest wisdom shouldn’t live only in classrooms, and built Dive Into Reiki to prove it. Through her podcast and long-form interviews, she sits down with the elders and innovators of the practice — the medical pioneers, the Japanese-lineage scholars, the animal reiki founders — and draws out the kind of honest, unhurried conversation that turns curiosity into genuine understanding. The result is one of the richest free archives in the reiki world — a living oral history of the practice, distilled into her book Infinite Light: Conversations with 21 Reiki Masters and Practitioners — gathered by someone the masters themselves trust.

Her own training runs as deep as her questions. A traditional Japanese-style reiki master with over fifteen years of practice, Nathalie is a graduate teacher of the International House of Reiki under Frans Stiene, travelled to Japan to train in Zen Buddhism at the Chokai-san International Zendo, and holds a second-degree black belt in the sword art of Iaido — discipline she brings to a teaching style students describe as grounded, warm, and quietly profound. The author of Reiki as a Spiritual Practice: An Illustrated Guide (published in five languages) and The Reiki Healing Handbook, she has demonstrated reiki everywhere from Soho House to the New York Jets’ training centre to Fashion Week — carrying the practice, with reverence and humour, into rooms it has never been before.

books.title: Reiki as a Spiritual Practice: an Illustrated Guide
books.author: Nathalie Jaspar
books.description: A beautifully illustrated guide to Reiki as a complete spiritual path, not just a hands-on healing technique. Nathalie walks you through a self-healing protocol, traditional Japanese meditations and simple daily tools to deepen your personal practice. Now published in five languages, it's a gentle, grounded companion for practitioners at every level.

books.title: Reiki Healing Handbook: How to Activate Energy Healing with Chakras, Symbols, and Hand Positions
books.author: Nathalie Jaspar
books.description: A clear, practical handbook for anyone ready to bring Reiki into everyday life. Nathalie explains the hand positions, symbols and chakra work step by step, so readers can confidently channel healing energy for themselves and others. It's warm, accessible and rooted in tradition, an ideal first book for new practitioners.

books.title: Infinite Light: Conversations with 21 Reiki masters and practitioners
books.author: Nathalie Jaspar
books.description: Drawn from the Dive Into Reiki podcast, this collection brings together honest, unhurried conversations with 21 of the practice's leading masters, scholars and innovators. It traces the lineages, histories and personal journeys that shape modern Reiki, and is a living oral history of the practice. It will appeal to anyone who wants to understand Reiki from the people who've devoted their lives to it.

courses.title: Reiki Mentorship Programs
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring for trained practitioners and teachers who feel stuck, want to return to their practice, or want to go deeper before teaching. It covers daily self-care ritual, symbols, offering sessions without depletion, and Reiki's Japanese spiritual roots.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate (Reiki Meditation One-on-One Classes)
courses.description: Private Reiki-based meditation classes, with either three or six 45-minute sessions. They suit busy minds, empaths and anyone who has struggled with meditation, and you don't need any Reiki training. You'll learn grounding, emotional-trigger and energy-alignment meditations and build a daily routine.

courses.title: Dive Into Reiki Patreon
courses.description: An ongoing virtual practice community with live-stream practice groups for each Reiki level, plus exclusive articles, meditation how-tos and Q&As. It's open to practitioners of all lineages, members get 10% off certification classes, and new members get a free half-hour mentorship session.
